overclaim_search_hits.text: A minimal path registry would associate each target execution setting with its qualification scope: model artifacts, runtime revision, numerical options, context/output conditions, and the evaluated workload. Selection would consider only paths admitted by the active contract. Changing the runtime, quantization, or execution shape would invalidate the relevant qualification rather than inherit it silently. This registry is proposed metadata and policy, not a claim that a finite test suite proves correctness for every possible input.

\caption{Why does isolated NPU speed not survive integration on 358H? Left: median isolated steady-state draft throughput (five repetitions/cell), excluding the first-token cost. Right: arithmetic mean complete post-prefill request time over 90 observations/path. CPU time is target-side dominated (\HcpuTarget\%); NPU time is replay-plus-proposal dominated (\HnpuDraft\%). Residuals are only \HcpuResidual\%/\HnpuResidual\% and visually negligible. Separate boundaries preclude interpreting left-panel throughput as realized draft cost.}
